title: "step_03 — India results"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Purpose.** Report the predeclared India endpoints.

```{r}
meta <- nb_require("meta_endpoints.csv", "step_03")
pe <- nb_require("paired_e1.csv", "step_03")
nb_assert_cols(meta, c("endpoint", "median_delta", "boot_lo", "boot_hi",
                       "sign_k", "sign_n", "sign_p"), "meta endpoints")
e1 <- meta[endpoint == "E1"]; e2 <- meta[endpoint == "E2"]
knitr::kable(data.table(
  endpoint = c("E1 concurrent", "E2 prospective"),
  n = c(e1$n_gauges, e2$n_gauges),
  median_dBrier = round(c(e1$median_delta, e2$median_delta), 6),
  ci = sprintf("[%.6f, %.6f]", c(e1$boot_lo, e2$boot_lo),
               c(e1$boot_hi, e2$boot_hi)),
  sign = sprintf("%d/%d", c(e1$sign_k, e2$sign_k), c(e1$sign_n, e2$sign_n)),
  p = round(c(e1$sign_p, e2$sign_p), 3),
  median_dAUC = round(c(e1$median_delta_auc, e2$median_delta_auc), 4)
), caption = "India: paired SSI-3 vs SSI-3+queue")
```

`[measurement]` Both confirmatory Brier endpoints are null: the interval includes
zero and the sign test is non-significant. AUC is positive but secondary.
